upstreamSourceReview.scope: The new committed change registers body glyphs in the renderer dependency graph and adds loading-screen parity/isolation checks; it remains a host concern. Additional uncommitted glyph, presence/shape, data and generation work is preserved as observed and is not imported into the SDK.

performance.decision: Keep compiled shared recency rows. Two desktop runs show stable sampling 36–49% faster than the initial extraction but 13–15% slower than published v0.31; changing samples improve 10–12% over initial while remaining 6–7% slower than v0.31. No whole-world speedup or retained-memory improvement established.

developmentCorrections: Original fixtures and the fourteen-case publication-recovery decision were committed before implementation; the original seven re-entry diagnostic courses remain unchanged rather than being relabeled byte-equal.

Failed publication retries replacement without duplicating already committed edges; same-actor refresh/invalidation re-entry is rejected before reads or mutation. Conditions and gauges confirm independently.

Initial measurements rejected frozen tuple unpacking as the final optimized implementation. Retained initial/source controls stay immutable while the shared scalar-row refactor is measured and verified.
The unchanged portability guard rejected a metadata field named window; it was renamed seconds before the accepted full verification and measurements.
Distinct recency-window tests pin counter indexing, strict expiry and the hurt inverse.
verifierScope: Final runtime bytes match full SDK, installed faults, original comparisons and controlled measurements. The final documentation archive and exact-commit hosted checks are separate gates.
limits: Eleven of thirteen families remain partial. Host event production and timing, native effect/spatial mechanics, full engine packages, later source/content reconciliation and Steam Deck/older-mobile acceptance remain incomplete. No allocation-volume or frame-rate claim.
